description: The image is a close-up photograph of three glazed donuts arranged on a plate. The plate is white with a brown trim and holds three donuts: one glazed, one with a yellow icing and small black dots, and one with a brown icing. The donut on the left is fully glazed, while the middle donut has brown icing on its bottom half and yellow icing on its top half, adorned with small black dots resembling chocolate chips. The third donut is fully glazed with brown icing
